IFACE.description: The name of the bond interface being managed (e.g., bond0). Passed as environment variable by the init script.

IF_BOND_PRIMARY.description: List of candidate interfaces for primary slave selection. Passed as environment variable by the init script.

VERBOSITY.description: Verbosity level for the script. 1 enables set -x debugging. Passed as environment variable.

ADDRFAM.description: Address family filter. If 'meta', the script exits immediately. Passed as environment variable.
